name: Editorial Serif Revival
summary: Large expressive serif headlines, warm off-white paper, a small sans for labels and a restrained palette. It came back as a reaction to the geometric sans-serif default of the SaaS web.

philosophy.core_thesis: Voice beats neutrality: a serif with character makes a brand sound like a person, as in a magazine.
design_principles: Set headlines in a high-contrast serif at 56px to 120px with a leading of 0.95 to 1.05 and tracking of -0.02em to -0.04em.
Use a warm off-white ground (#F6F1E7) and near-black ink (#1A1714); one muted accent (terracotta #A64B25 or green) covers less than 8% of the surface.
Set body in a serif or a quiet sans at 18px to 20px with a measure of 55 to 70 characters and a leading of 1.55.
Set labels, dates and bylines in a small sans or mono at 11px to 13px in upper case with +0.08em tracking.
Use italic as the emphasis in a headline: one word or phrase in italic in each headline.
Divide the page by 1px rules; use drop caps and pull quotes at 32px to 48px.
Crop photographs in clean rectangles with a caption of 12px below and no radius.
anti_patterns: Stock illustration in a corporate-flat style

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; headlines span 8 to 10 columns; body sits in 6 columns; captions in the margin.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35% to 50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; ragged right; large headlines may span the width; pull quotes sit off the column.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px radius; 1px rules and plain image crops; no card boxes.

font_pairings.note: A condensed display serif with a neutral label sans.
An expressive soft serif with a text serif for reading.
A classic high-contrast display with a clear text serif.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.02em to -0.04em; body stays at 0; labels take +0.08em.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights for the text face: regular (400) and semibold (600); display runs at 400.
Set one phrase of a headline in italic.
Set labels in upper case at 12px.

color.palette_structure: Warm paper and ink, with one muted accent.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on paper holds at least 15:1; the accent carries labels, links and one large word, not body text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat paper tone with a grain at 3% opacity; no gradient.
color.light_and_shadow: None; depth comes from scale and white space.

materiality.surface_simulation: Printed magazine paper: warm stock and black ink.
materiality.border_rules: 1px ink rules above sections and under headlines; no boxes.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. No elevation. Shadow is none.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin 1.5px line icons used rarely; text links with arrows (→) replace most icons.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Editorial photography and illustration in a single tone, with captions and credits.

motion.transition_physics: Calm fades of 300ms to 500ms; images reveal by a 12px upward slide; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover adds an underline of 1px in the accent and shifts an arrow by 4px; active state darkens the accent by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that a person with taste is speaking.

avoid_when: The product is a dense dashboard.
The brand needs a technical or playful look.
The page needs many cards and filters.

modifiers.how: Replace the serif with one neo-grotesque and use a flush-left 12-column grid.
Set body in the default serif, remove the paper tone and add 2px rules.
Switch to a near-black ground and add a mono face for labels.

pack.why: A thin, even, humanist line that does not compete with the serif headlines.

ground.why: Editorial pages are set on a column grid with a rule of ink across the masthead.
